title: Apply state-bound model retirement without corrupting retained history
statement: The MOD-001 responsibility shall apply state-bound model retirement without corrupting retained history within the exact selected scope, preserving original meaning and explicit incomplete outcomes.

what.problem: Conditional current-model publication and removal custody can otherwise conflate preparation with confirmed effects or hide unavailable content.
what.desired_outcome: Apply state-bound model retirement without corrupting retained history.

why.rationale: SR-024 requires this accountable architectural contribution; other contributions retain their own owners.

conditions: A participant requests conditional current-model publication and removal custody.

contexts: The selected local project state and declared retained/current material under state-control.md.

how.approach: Apply state-control.md with exact identity/scope and original interpretation, explicit custody/authority boundaries and attributable incomplete or confirmed outcomes.

how_much.scope: Conditional current-model publication and removal custody. No full IR003 assessment, runtime qualification, destructive adoption or operational maintenance execution is claimed.

acceptance_criteria: Accept only exact current-model removal/replacement scope with expected state, applicable authority and resolved reliance/recovery basis; never treat a prepared disposition as execution permission.

Require executor-held cross-custody quiescence/exclusion through final reliance/authority checks, effects and reconciliation, in addition to model write exclusion; verify the exact base/resulting-model rules, preserve replacements and never touch immutable retained bundles.
Persist unresolved-write scope before effects and block coherent affected reads and further writes after partial or uncertain publication until exact effects are reconciled.
Report actual retained, replaced, removed and unresolved membership; changed bases reject, unrelated work remains untouched and failure cannot imply rollback or complete cleanup.
constraints: Proposed Design; no implementation, executed criterion verification or satisfaction claim.

sources.basis: Define immutable baseline custody, original-meaning comparison/recovery, attributable transition preparation and dependency-safe retirement. Preserve selective retention and separate action authority, operational maintenance and actual execution; proposed Design only.
